author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: असम्प्रज्ञातसमाधिरूपयाऽऽत्मनि स्थित्यैव सन्तुष्टो न त्वन्येन केनापीत्येवकारार्थः । अत्र मानव इति उक्तिः अपरोक्षिण एवासम्प्रज्ञातसमाधिरिति द्योतयितुम् । यस्त्वेवंरूपः तस्य कार्यं कर्तव्यं संध्यावन्दनादिकं किमपि कर्म न विद्यते
translation: V. The particle Tu (whereas) points to the particular circumstance of being immersed in meditation. Manavah: perfect in wisdom, comes from the root man, to think, to understand, and means one who has risen to the full and direct perception of the Lord. Atman throughout the verse denotes only the Paramatman, the Supreme Being. Atmarati may be dissolved into Atmani + rati= one who finds delight in the Lord, or into Atmanah+rati=one who derives delight from Atman.
